narrative.intro: Mission Support and Test Services obligated $953M in FY2026 to date. Mission Support and Test Services received 5 federal awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $191M and obligations down 4.2% year over year. Fiscal-year totals show variation: FY21 obligations were $855M, FY22 obligations were $923M, FY23 obligations were $838M, FY24 obligations were $1.1B, FY25 obligations were $995M, and FY26 obligations are $953M. The Department of Energy is the dominant buyer, obligating $953M. Facilities Support Services is the primary NAICS market with $953M in obligations. A smaller portion of activity appears in General Automotive Repair with $77.7K in obligations, and the General Services Administration accounts for $77.7K in buying. All figures are contract obligations except where noted otherwise, and current-year totals are fiscal year to date. This profile reflects contract obligation volumes and buyer concentration without addressing contract values listed elsewhere or future expectations.
